items.flag: B4 README owner item: the beginner bank mixes 3603.95 / 8189.63 with the lessons' 3603.96 / 8189.64
items.reason: The engine divides the LAS-stored DT 277.4726 (float32 277.4725952), giving 3603.9595 m/s and Z 8189.6372, so 3603.96 and 8189.64 are the correctly rounded values; 3603.95 only comes from dividing the three-decimal 277.473. Explanations and options now use the engine values and name the stored DT. 2605.14 was also a mis-rounding of the engine 2605.1455.

explanation.old: At 1600 m, v = 2605.14 and Z = 5885.8. At 1650 m, v = 3603.95 and Z = 8189.63. The difference is about 2304 in favour of 1650 m. The densities are almost identical, so nearly all of the impedance change comes from the sonic log.
